project.name: Surgical Video Segmentation with DINOv2-UNet
project.scope: Semi-supervised 2D segmentation of surgical video frames under limited annotations, illumination variation and instrument occlusion.
project.method: DINOv2 ViT encoder with lightweight CNN decoder, trained under a Semantic Mean Teacher framework with freeze-thaw adaptation and weak-to-strong consistency.

code_structure.train.py: semi-supervised training entrypoint (Mean Teacher, EMA teacher, freeze-thaw schedule)
code_structure.dataset.py: labeled / unlabeled datasets, mask parsing, weak and strong augmentation
code_structure.model_factory.py: DINOv2-UNet and baseline segmentation models, Dice + Focal loss
code_structure.utils.py: seeding, logging, device selection, metric quality weighting

dataset.name: Surgical video frame dataset
dataset.train_val_split: by video identity, 80% annotated frames for training and 20% for validation

model.architecture: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 encoder + lightweight CNN decoder
model.decoder: 1x1 channel projection to 256 + bilinear upsampling, concatenated with a shallow CNN texture stem, fused by a lightweight CNN decoder
model.fusion: multi-level fusion of global ViT semantics and local CNN boundary detail

training.lr_schedule: linear warmup (5 epochs) followed by cosine annealing
training.unsupervised_loss: BCE on high-confidence pseudo-labels (pos_thr=0.70, neg_thr=0.10, min_area=80)
training.freeze_thaw: freeze DINOv2 encoder for 20 epochs, then unfreeze and fine-tune with encoder_lr
training.precision: AMP mixed precision with gradient clipping at norm 1.0

inference.protocol: student best checkpoint selected on validation score, four-way flip TTA, checkpoint-selected threshold, no morphological post-processing

notes: Only 180 of 1559 frames carry pixel-level annotations, so unlabeled frames are exploited through pseudo-label supervision.
The DINOv2 encoder supplies large-scale self-supervised semantic priors, which stabilizes pseudo-label generation under severe occlusion.
Pseudo-label quality is guarded against collapse by minimum-area filtering and a minimum foreground-ratio check.
Dataset files are not redistributed by this repository; frames must be obtained from the original source and placed under data/surgical_video/.
